dot.$description: control.size.sm dot — 8px inner mark for a control whose mark is a filled shape, i.e. a radio's dot (half the 16px box edge, leaving a 4px gap to the boundary). A control whose mark is a GLYPH draws it full-bleed at `height` instead.
